caption: The drawing features a horizontal decorative border set against a plain, off-white background. The border is composed of a repeating pattern with stylized motif elements. The primary colors used in the border are shades of green, gold, brown, and yellow. The motif consists of a sequence of gold and brown ornamental shapes reminiscent of flowers or fans, each with a downward-pointing, gold-accented inverted triangle underneath, and a small yellow dot near its tip. Between these repeating elements, there are elongated green hanging forms, each ending in a pointed tip. The border itself is framed at the top and bottom by multiple parallel stripes in dark brown, gold, and green tones. The design is centered on the page, with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Wallpaper
